scope: Each persona with a strategy pool runs one daily Observe-Orient-Decide-Act-Learn pool cycle inside the existing persona daily-cycle consumer; persona-written research_demand.v1 records are stored by the research owner; the discovery allocator and its schedule are removed.

changes.pool_cycle: services/persona/pool_autonomy_cycle.py: deterministic decide() (open_demand | admit_trial | reweight | remove | propose_mutate | propose_widen | no_action with reason) and PoolAutonomyCycle.run(), which never raises (skip/failure recorded per persona). HttpPoolCyclePorts calls only existing owner routes (persona strategy-pool decisions, research demands, evolution proposals, memory learn-feedback pool_outcome).
changes.schedule_entry: services/persona/persona_cycle_controller.py consume_run runs the pool cycle after Observe/risk on an ok cron run and writes the result into the same daily OODA packet (pool_autonomy plus observe/orient/decide/act/learn refs); services/control-plane/persona/main.py wires it behind the existing PERSONA_DAILY_CYCLE_ENABLED lifespan. These two files are outside the declared artifact list but are the real schedule entry (cron_ooda_closure refuses daily-cycle runs).
changes.demand_record: docs/contracts/research_demand.v1.schema.json and services/research/research_demand.py with routes POST/GET /api/research/persona-demands and POST .../reconcile in services/research/main.py: one open demand per persona and short measure, satisfied by a member that joined after creation, expires 30 days after creation.
changes.allocator_removed: services/research/discovery_allocator.py, its two test files, the startup schedule and port wiring in services/research/main.py, and DISCOVERY_ALLOCATOR_* in docker-compose.yml are deleted; nothing else creates discovery capital bindings.

verification.result: 103 passed, 4 failed; the 4 failures are environmental (asyncpg and QuantLib not installed in the review venv); the two persona-lifespan failures reproduce on the unchanged baseline.

acceptance_evidence.1_2_daily_cycle_and_decisions: test_persona_cycle_demand_integration drives PersonaCycleController.consume_run twice; each packet carries pool_autonomy with observe, orient, decide, act receipts and learn. Policy cases in test_pool_autonomy_cycle.
acceptance_evidence.3_demand: test_research_demand covers dedupe, tenant scope, satisfaction by a later member, 30-day expiry, schema refusal; the integration test shows mandate, missing datasets, tried families and short measure on the stored record.
acceptance_evidence.4_memory_and_tried: Refused admissions and removals are written as pool_outcome memory with tried_family tags; recalled families are excluded from candidates and listed in the next demand (test_demand_carries_..., test_refused_admission_...).
acceptance_evidence.5_allocator_removed: Files deleted; test_http_routes_... asserts no discovery_allocator_ports or discovery routes.
acceptance_evidence.7_integration: Two consecutive cycles through PersonaCycleController.consume_run: open_demand then admit_trial, with only owner HTTP and the model turn faked. The admitted candidate is built from the governed 2-year Taiwan dataset (build_governed_tw_replication_dataset, 760 bars, down_drop=-0.055): canonical lookback-2 momentum artifact with its own fresh real ReplicationGate proof (registry/promotion verification path, no checksum or owner_verified_binding rewrite), pool current member = momentum_threshold 0.002 variant with its own gate proof. Unmodified pool_policy: correlation 0.46 < 0.5, candidate OOS Sharpe ~8.0 above trial threshold, combined Sharpe improves; the pool store applies the admit as a trial member and the displaced weakest member removal is learned. The same suite keeps the genuine recorded-fixture refusal (corr ~0.90 / Sharpe below trial threshold) asserted in the packet and memory (tried_family tag).

known_limits.dataset_loader: Admission dataset comes from governed_dataset_loader (configured canonical dataset + threshold policy paths, same evaluation authority research uses; wired in control-plane/persona/main.py). Unconfigured or rejected authority fails closed as not_attempted:governed_dataset_unavailable; nothing is synthesised.
known_limits.widen: propose_widen is staged only; there is no permitted-universe owner, so no widening authority is inferred.
known_limits.candidate_source: Candidates are resolved from completed alpha-replication entries to approved gate-passed registry execution bundles (lineage.source_strategy_spec_id); real-data admission stays with PERSONA-AUTONOMY-HOSTED-ACCEPTANCE-20261112.
known_limits.verification_boundary: The two-day integration test pins only evaluation_authority.load_evaluation_authority to the recorded TWSE dataset and fakes owner HTTP and the model turn; CycleOwners.observe is a stub that, like telemetry, returns books only for live bound members. Real telemetry, hosted dataset authority and hosted registry were not exercised.

reopen_fixes.owner_credentials: HttpPoolCyclePorts now uses the persona service's configured owner-specific principals (PERSONA_RESEARCH_SERVICE_TOKEN issued by scripts/issue_dev_paper_principals.py into the persona volume, PANTHEON_MEMORY_AUTH_TOKEN, EVOLUTION_AUTH_TOKEN, PERSONA_REGISTRY_SERVICE_TOKEN) read via configured_service_token (rotating _FILE aware); an unset credential raises owner_credential_unconfigured instead of sending an empty bearer. Persona owner calls are in-process through the pool store (no self-HTTP). docker-compose persona service wires the env.
reopen_fixes.governed_dataset: services/control-plane/persona/main.py constructs HttpPoolCyclePorts(pool_store, dataset_loader=governed_dataset_loader()); the loader reads the governed evaluation authority (PERSONA_POOL_CANONICAL_DATASET_PATH / THRESHOLD_POLICY_PATH, falling back to TRAINING_SESSION_*) and fails closed when unconfigured. Deployment must supply the canonical dataset path; none is defaulted.
reopen_fixes.prior_risk_removal: PoolAutonomyCycle diffs the observed pool against the owner's current pool, writes risk-owner removals to the persona memory (tried_family tags) before recall, and excludes those families from demand tried_families and candidates.
reopen_fixes.tests: services/persona/test_pool_autonomy_cycle.py (+2), integration test now uses real pool store and governed_dataset_loader (only owner HTTP and the authority snapshot reader pinned to recorded TWSE data). Not covered: end-to-end scheduled risk removal through the controller with real observations.

reopen_fixes_2.candidate_book: pool_autonomy_cycle.candidate_virtual_book (reusing pool_admission._replay) replays the candidate's registry artifact over the governed dataset's untouched window (same interpreter/netting as admission, NET_BASIS, source_ref governed-replay:<dataset_id>); HttpPoolCyclePorts.candidate_book supplies it as books[candidate]. Replay failure records not_attempted:candidate_book_unavailable with no owner call and no fabricated returns. Integration test Observe now returns books only for live members.
reopen_fixes_2.removal_learning: A successful admission learns every removed member by before/after diff plus decision.replaced_artifact_ref, with family, so removed families are tagged tried_family and excluded from the next demand (integration asserts memory_entries == [admitted, removed]).
reopen_fixes_2.pool_failure_health: persona_cycle_controller sets failure_reason pool_cycle_failed:<reason> when the pool cycle fails, so the packet stays observing and cycle health is not completed; failures remain per-persona.
